kb.title: AUTOMATIC BULLION BARS PRODUCTION SYSTEM Mod IT.KB
short:
ITALTHERM Automatic Vacuum (Bullion Bars) Casting Systems, engineered for both exceptional results and remarkable ease of use.

Featuring custom-shaped induction coils with integrated cooling technology, our proprietary process ensures uniform temperature distribution. The intelligent cooling system actively regulates mold temperature throughout the cycle, producing consistently brilliant, flawlessly flat surfaces that meet the highest market standards.

Engineered for Continuous Industrial Performance, our machines maintain consistent performance under demanding production schedules. The robust construction and refined thermal management ensure reliable output for high-volume manufacturing environments.

bf.title: CONTROLLED ATMOSPHERE BELT FURNACE MODEL IT.BF
short:
ItalTherm Mesh Belt Heat Treatment Furnace.

A continuous‑process furnace for welding, brazing, sintering, and annealing metal components. The mesh‑belt system ensures uninterrupted production, while an inert‑gas atmosphere and oxygen‑burning barrier prevent oxidation. The furnace features programmable PID temperature control, independent heating zones, and a controlled cooling section for consistent, high‑quality results across a wide range of applications.

gt.title: GEAR-DRIVEN TILTING METAL MELTING FURNACE MODEL IT.GT
short:
ItalTherm Gear-Driven Tilting Metal Melting Furnace delivers robust capabilities for melting precious metals such as gold, silver, with capacities ranging from 20 kg to 50 kg.

Equipped with energy-efficient medium frequency induction power generator and precise temperature control for rapid and uniform heating.

The tilting mechanism is driven by a cost-effective gear reduction drive system with smooth controlled tilting and precise Curved Pouring Trajectory.

mt.title: MANUAL TILTING METAL MELTING FURNACE MODEL IT.MT
short:
ItalTherm Manual tilting metal melting furnace is a compact and efficient solution for melting precious metals such as gold, silver, with capacities ranging from 1 kg to 15 kg.

Equipped with advanced electromagnetic induction heating technology, the furnace can reach melting temperatures within 3–5 minutes, allowing efficient melting and homogeneous alloys.

Its fully integrated design, combining the tilting mechanism and power supply into a single unit, ensures easy and convenient pouring operation and minimizes risks and space requirements.

fm.title: VACUUM FLAKE PRODUCTION SYSTEM IT.FM
short:
ITALTHERM Metal Flake Making Machine is specially designed to make gold and silver dry and thin flakes, which greatly improves refining efficiency.

After melting, the material is directly formed into thin flakes ≤0.1mm in size, these thin flaks dissolve rapidly and completely in the chemical reagents Sealed operation and inert gas protection isolate oxygen throughout the process, preventing high-temperature oxidation.
